method: Skeptic tree from git archive@4ec961e (aisef2 aisef tests validation docs pyproject.toml); closure-evidence/v2/release/LEDGERLOCK-PROJECT.json (sha256 157858a0...0f3a4) added via git show (the kill file's fixture reads it). Each mutant rebuilt from the pristine source via validation.v2.mutation.mutants(src, func, _enum_members(src,'.'))[INDEX] with desc asserted == the batch entry's mutant string, and cross-checked against the campaign's own tools/mutant_view.py diff; written over aisef2/app/bundle_cli.py in a run-copy. Env: env -i, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin (strips ~/.opencode/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin, the two dirs with an executable opencode), HOME/TMPDIR under the tree, PYTHONPATH=run-copy, nice -n 19 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -P -B -m unittest, one mutant at a time, module restored to pristine between mutants. Baselines: raw pristine 51 OK; null_mutant (normalized, unmutated) 51 OK -> the AST round-trip the generator applies is behaviour-preserving, so 51 OK == SURVIVED is the correct criterion.
